firmware.releaseNotes: Fix the owner-reported 3.3.41 check-update page: remove repeated phone/connection instructions, display only validated current version, and show mutually exclusive Check/Install actions beside Back/Later without overlap. Preserve P01 offered-update and U01 transfer rendering, explicit consent, reminder suppression, power/recording/storage gates, Boot/configuration/user data, keys and protocol. Source-bound real-LVGL/control/safety/menu regressions pass 74 tests, including two reproduced pre-fix failures. This new immutable candidate is for the owner-requested direct J-Link UI inspection; do not overwrite 3.3.41, 3.3.42 or 3.3.43. No automatic channel publication or delta generation. App 1.0.88+114 is unchanged and must not be rebuilt. Direct installation advances the device baseline to 3.3.44; later owner-controlled delta targets must be planned from that verified baseline, not the old 3.3.41 to 3.3.42 to 3.3.43 matrix.
